reply:
`git stash` only stashes tracked changes by default—untracked files stay in the working tree. You need `-u` for untracked files and `-a` for ignored files.

Cost of this mistake: untracked files can get deleted or overwritten when you switch branches, losing work silently.

grade.note: Reply reverses prior claim, correctly explains -u/-a flags matching developer and ground truth.
